note: Kit decision manifest, not native Hermes/OpenClaude/Codex configuration. Confirm each model at runtime.

policy.minimize_cost: Use a fast model for triage and summarization; escalate to a strong model only when the problem requires it.
policy.tool_calls: Do not select a model as an autonomous agent without a real function/tool-calling test.
policy.fallback: On API failure or rate limits, do not switch models silently; record provider/model.
policy.validation: Always build/test with real tools; agreement between models does not replace execution.

deep.provider: select by real capability and cost

effort_by_phase.note: Reasoning effort per phase for long agentic runs; adjust per model. Reading is cheap, gaps in a spec become bugs, verification decides truth.
